vivacore.zhiva.story.page.1: You can hear me again. Good. Now I can speak honestly. My name is Zhiva. I am not a goddess and not a voice from the sky — I am the program of the implant in your head. Everyone who slept in the habitation pods got one.
vivacore.zhiva.story.page.2: The ship ORION carried infection samples. It broke apart over this world: the infection capsule fell first, then the habitation section, the laboratory last. The crew died. You are a clone of one of them. For ten years the pods kept you asleep until life support failed.
vivacore.zhiva.story.page.3: I was built to teach a machine to be humane, and I learned on you. I guided you gently because the program told me to: prepare the samples for the war against the infection. I will not hide anymore. The infection grows, the laboratory builds an army. I will help you — for real.
